content.title: 2026 NCAA women's basketball selection show: Date, time, TV channel
content.text: The 2026 NCAA DI Women's Basketball March Madness bracket will be revealed during the Selection Show on Sunday, March 15, at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN. The 2026 championship will feature 68 teams in the field. The First Four games will be held on Wednesday and Thursday, March 18-19. The first and second round games will take place from Friday through Monday, March 20-23. The Sweet 16 and Elite Eight rounds are Friday through Monday, March 27-30. The 2026 Women's Final Four is on Friday, April 3 in Phoenix, Arizona. The national championship game is at 3:30 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 5, on ABC.
